inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.description: Workspace id, e.g. ws_7Q2K9XH3AB

inputs.name: site_id
inputs.description: Id of the site to export, like pa_7Q2K9XH3AB (from sites_list). Required

inputs.name: kind
inputs.description: What to export. aggregated (default) is visit metrics per time bucket and dimension. pageviews, events and raw are one row per hit (pageviews only, custom events only, every hit) and need the Pro plan or above. imported is imported daily stats. dashboard is a ZIP of the overview panels

inputs.name: file_format
inputs.description: File type, default csv. Allowed per kind: csv, json or xlsx for aggregated, pageviews, events and imported. csv or ndjson for raw. zip for dashboard

inputs.name: from
inputs.description: First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD, in the export timezone. Required

inputs.name: to
inputs.description: Last day to include (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD, on or after from. Required. At most 400 days from from (93 days for raw)

inputs.name: timezone
inputs.description: IANA timezone name used for dates and time buckets, like America/New_York. Default is the site timezone

inputs.name: grouping
inputs.description: Time bucket for aggregated exports (also used by dashboard): hour, day (default), week, month, quarter or year

inputs.name: dimensions
inputs.description: Up to 6 names to group by. For aggregated: channel, referrer, referrer_url, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content, utm_term, ref, hostname, country, language, device, browser, browser_version, os, os_version, screen, entry_page, exit_page or interaction. For imported: total, page, source, country, device, browser or os. Ignored for other kinds

inputs.name: metrics
inputs.description: Metric columns for aggregated exports. Empty means all of them

inputs.name: fields
inputs.description: Columns for pageviews, events and raw exports. Empty means all except visit_id, vital_value and selector. props only includes event properties marked safe to export. revenue_minor is in minor currency units. Ignored for other kinds

inputs.name: filters
inputs.description: List of filters, each a three item array [dimension, operator, value] like [["country","is","US"]], same format as the stats tools. Applies to aggregated, pageviews, events, raw and dashboard. Empty means no filter

inputs.name: segment_id
inputs.description: Id of a saved segment, like seg_..., from segments_list. Its filters are added to filters. Must be shared or your own. Ignored for imported

inputs.name: workspace_id
inputs.description: Workspace id, e.g. ws_7Q2K9XH3AB

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Partial, case-insensitive match on the member's name or email.

inputs.name: role
inputs.description: Only members with this role, one of owner, admin, editor, analyst, viewer, billing or custom.

inputs.name: workspace_id

inputs.name: emails
inputs.description: Up to 50 email addresses to invite. Addresses that are already members are skipped.

inputs.name: role
inputs.description: Role for the invited people, one of admin, editor, analyst, viewer, billing or custom. Default viewer. Use custom together with custom_role_id. Owner cannot be invited.

inputs.name: custom_role_id
inputs.description: Id (uuid) of a custom role from roles_list. Required when role is custom (Business plan).

inputs.name: all_sites
inputs.description: true (default) gives access to every site including future ones. Set false to limit access to site_ids.

inputs.name: site_ids
inputs.description: Public site ids (pa_..., from sites_list) the invited people may access. Only used when all_sites is false.

testimonials_list.summary: List the testimonials of a site, filtered and sorted

inputs.name: site_id
inputs.description: Site id, e.g. pa_7Q2K9XH3AB

inputs.name: view_id
inputs.description: A saved view to apply (vw_...). Its filters, search text, sort, layout and columns are used, and any other input given beside it overrides the view's value for that input

inputs.name: layout
inputs.description: list, cards, board or highlights. Returned in meta.layout. It changes nothing about which testimonials are listed

inputs.name: columns
inputs.description: Columns of the list layout. Returned in meta.columns

inputs.name: q
inputs.description: The search box. Words and "quoted phrases" search the text, title, person and company. Operators: status: kind: source: from: form: tag: collection: lang: has: is: consent: received: person: company: email: used: mentions: rating: and prop.<key>:. A comma means any of, a leading minus excludes, and terms are joined with and. Example: rating:5 has:video tag:onboarding "saved us"

inputs.name: sort
inputs.description: received_desc (the default), received_asc, added_desc, added_asc, rating_desc, rating_asc, person_asc, length_desc, length_asc, used_desc, used_asc, or relevance (the default when q has words, and only allowed then)

inputs.name: status
inputs.description: Any of pending, approved, rejected

inputs.name: kind
inputs.description: Any of text, video, audio

inputs.name: rating
inputs.description: Any of 1 to 5 (as strings), and none for no rating

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: Any of form, import, manual, extension, api, migration

inputs.name: source_name
inputs.description: Platform or source names as stored, e.g. Google

inputs.name: form_id
inputs.description: Form ids (frm_...) or form names

inputs.name: tag_id
inputs.description: Tag ids (tag_...) or tag names

inputs.name: tag_match
inputs.description: any (the default) matches any of the tags, all needs every one

inputs.name: untagged
inputs.description: yes for testimonials with no tag. With tag_id, either matches

inputs.name: collection_id
inputs.description: Collection ids (col_...) or names. A smart collection is read as its rules

inputs.name: no_collection
inputs.description: yes for testimonials in no manual collection

inputs.name: language
inputs.description: Language codes, e.g. de

inputs.name: has_photo
inputs.description: yes or no. The person has a photo

inputs.name: has_video
inputs.description: yes or no. A video file is attached

inputs.name: has_image
inputs.description: yes or no. An image is attached

inputs.name: consent
inputs.description: granted for consent on record, source_only for a source record

inputs.name: consent_permission
inputs.description: Permissions that must all be granted

inputs.name: verified
inputs.description: yes or no

inputs.name: received
inputs.description: A preset: today, 7d, 30d, 90d, this_year, last_year

inputs.name: received_from
inputs.description: First day received (YYYY-MM-DD), on the site's clock

inputs.name: received_to
inputs.description: Last day received (YYYY-MM-DD)

inputs.name: age
inputs.description: Freshness: any of 0_6m, 6_12m, 1_2y, over_2y

inputs.name: person_id
inputs.description: Person ids (per_...)

inputs.name: company
inputs.description: Company names or website hosts

inputs.name: properties
inputs.description: Custom property values by key, e.g. {"plan": ["Team"]}. A number range is "10..50", yes or no is "yes" or "no", and "none" means not filled

inputs.name: usage
inputs.description: unused, used, or used_3_plus

inputs.name: used_by
inputs.description: Ids of the widgets (wdg_...) or walls (wal_...) that show it

inputs.name: mention
inputs.description: Recurring terms to search for

inputs.name: has_highlight
inputs.description: yes or no

inputs.name: pinned
inputs.description: yes or no

inputs.name: edited
inputs.description: yes or no

inputs.name: waiting
inputs.description: yes or no. Waiting for allowance

inputs.name: duplicate
inputs.description: yes or no. In the duplicates queue

inputs.name: match
inputs.description: How the conditions are joined, all (the default) or any

inputs.name: conditions
inputs.description: Structured rows, each {"field", "operator", "value"}, e.g. [{"field": "rating", "operator": "is_at_least", "value": 4}]. Fields and operators are listed in the docs

inputs.name: trashed
inputs.description: true lists the trash and nothing else

inputs.name: facets
inputs.description: true adds the live count behind every facet value as meta.facets
